"''I concur with Captain Rex, sir. This is personal for us clones.|Captain Rex and Commander Cody, to Obi-Wan Kenobi|}} The '''Battle of Kamino''', a key campaign of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], was fought for control of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. Also known as the '''Invasion of Kamino''' or the '''Defense of Kamino''', the battle occurred when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] launched a massive assault aimed at crippling the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] main [[Kamino cloning chamber|cloning facilities]] in Kamino's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]]. Having collaborated during a [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|thwarted attempt]] to invade Kamino several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] earlier, rivals [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] and [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] were assigned by [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to lead the Separatist attack on Kamino. Joining [[High Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] and [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Lama Su/Legends|Lama Su]] in coordinating the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] defense of Kamino were [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] who, unwilling to lose the vital [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] factories, brought their [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] to reinforce the Grand [[Army/Legends|Army]] defenses. Ventress had already infiltrated Kamino by the [[Time/Legends|time]] Grievous arrived to [[Space warfare/Legends|beleaguer]] the Republic's [[Republic Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] with an invasion [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of his own. Although Skywalker led the Republic's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] against the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate armada]], the resulting [[Realspace/Legends|space]] engagement only served as a cover for elements of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] to land on Kamino via [[re-entry capsule]]s disguised as [[Starship/Legends|starship]] debris. After being reassembled by Ventress's [[Aqua droid/Legends|aqua droids]] in the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] of Kamino, the Separatist [[Trident-class assault ship/Legends|''Trident''-class assault ships]] launched their [[Troop/Legends|troops]] against Tipoca [[City/Legends|City]], and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and clones rushed to [[Ground warfare/Legends|repel]] Grievous and the invaders. Ventress went after a [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] sample of the Grand Army's [[Clone template/Legends|prime clone]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] but was intercepted by Skywalker, who [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]] the Dark Acolyte for the DNA sample. In a similar fashion, Grievous was [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|confronted]] by Kenobi while spearheading a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] assault on Tipoca City's clone [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]]. As the Separatist battle droids pressed further into Tipoca City, Kamino's elite [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commandos]] played a critical part in repulsing the enemy forces from the clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]' [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. While [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] organized a defense of the barracks, Ti led other troops in pushing back the droids to Tipoca City's main [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], where the invaders were eliminated. Ultimately, Grievous and Ventress failed to cripple Tipoca City as they had hoped thanks to the intervention of Kenobi and Skywalker, the latter of whom recovered the stolen DNA sample from Ventress. Skywalker attempted to have his clone troopers execute Ventress, but she escaped with Grievous aboard a [[Kaminoan flight pod/Legends|Kamino flight pod]]. Despite heavy losses, the Jedi and clones were able to drive the Separatists from Kamino. Two 501st troopers, [[Fives/Legends|Fives]] and [[Echo/Legends|Echo]], were awarded ARC trooper status for their performance in the battle. ==Prelude== ===Targeting Kamino=== {{Quote|The clone planet of Kamino will be a dangerous target.''"
''"Just make sure you hold up ''your'' half of the mission. We must stop the production of new clones if we are to win this war.|Asajj Ventress and General Grievous, in a transmission leaked to the Republic|}} During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], being home to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] vital [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] facilities for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], remained a prominent target for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] Kamino with a heavily fortified [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] as protection against the Confederacy, which hoped to cripple the Republic war machine and win a decisive victory in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict by stopping the Republic's production of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] at its source. Having failed to [[First Battle of Kamino|eliminate]] Kamino's cloning facilities[[Republic 50|''Republic'' 50]] early on in the war, the Confederacy staged another invasion of Kamino{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}} in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the war.{{TCWdates|105}} With the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] serving as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] on Kamino, Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] proceeded to the [[Kamino system/Legends|Kamino system]] with a massive invasion fleet. Yet he failed to [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|silence]] [[Rishi Station/Legends|Rishi Station]], a Republic [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] monitoring enemy activity near Kamino, and the Republic [[Navy/Legends|Navy]] was subsequently warned of the impending attack. [[File:GrievousVentress-KaminoARC.png|thumb|left|250px|Grievous and Ventress, rival agents of Dooku, were tasked with the invasion of Kamino.]] Although forced to retreat from the [[Rishi moon]], the Separatists remained determined to eliminate Kamino's cloning facilities. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], only several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after their previous attempt, Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] authorized another plan to attack Kamino, assigning rival [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] Grievous and Ventress to lead the invasion. While Grievous [[Space warfare/Legends|engaged]] the Republic blockade of Kamino, the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Separatist fleet]] would be allowed to sustain heavy losses. Under that cover, the main invasion force of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] would be sent down to the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] of Kamino aboard modules of [[Trident-class assault ship/Legends|''Trident''-class assault ships]] in [[re-entry capsule]]s. As the capsules would be disguised as debris from the destroyed [[Starship/Legends|starships]], the Republic would not realize the deception until too late. Once the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] was planet-side, Ventress—who was already on Kamino aboard her personal starship, the [[Trident (starship)/Legends|''Trident'']]—would have her detachment of [[Aqua droid/Legends|aqua droids]] reassemble the [[Assault ship/Legends|assault craft]] for the attack on Kamino's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]], where the main cloning facilities were located. As part of her espionage tasks, Ventress determined the exact locations of the clone [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]] and the [[Clone DNA room/Legends|DNA archive room]] in Tipoca [[City/Legends|City's]] [[Clone military education complex|Military Complex]], both of which would be primary targets during their assault. While Grievous led the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] assault on Tipoca City, specifically focusing on the clone barracks, Ventress would steal a [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] sample of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], the Grand [[Army/Legends|Army's]] [[Clone template/Legends|prime clone]]. With a copy of Fett's DNA, the Separatists hoped to uncover and exploit a weakness in the genetic code, with potentially catastrophic consequences for the Republic's clone troopers.{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars/?episodeID=8a250ab02b058b7b012b21ac33e70271|text=Dataclip: ARC Troopers|na=video file}} ===Jedi reinforcements=== {{Quote|I wish our arrival wasn't under such circumstances. We believe Grievous is planning a Separatist attack on Kamino.''"
"''But the Republic blockade is far too strong. They would not dare.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Lama Su|}} To draw the Republic and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] into their plan, the Confederacy allowed Republic forces to intercept an encoded transmission of Grievous and Ventress discussing their impending assault on Kamino. The communiqué was received aboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] of clone troopers, who were hosting [[High Jedi General/Legends|High General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] aboard their [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. After their crew decrypted the transmission's audio, Skywalker and Kenobi learned of the Separatists' targeting of Kamino, and their respective clone [[Officer/Legends|officers]], [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Marshal Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], were adamant about aiding the defense of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. Skywalker and Kenobi resolved to return to Kamino with the 501st [[Legion/Legends|Legion]] to notify the Republic defenses of the imminent attack and to provide extra protection against Grievous's [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]].''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Pocket Annual]]'' Once they had transferred their [[Troop/Legends|troops]] to an [[Unidentified Acclamator-class assault ship (Kamino)|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]], Skywalker and Kenobi proceeded to Tipoca City with the 501st Legion, while [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] took the ''Resolute'' to join the nine other ''Venator''-class Star Destroyers in the Republic's blockade of Kamino. Upon their arrival in Tipoca City, Skywalker and Kenobi met with [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Lama Su/Legends|Lama Su]] of Kamino and High General [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]], a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who had been stationed on Kamino as the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] General in charge of clone trooper training.{{SWArchive|url=clonewars/tradingcards/cards/tb_shaak_ti.jpg|text=Clone Card: Shaak Ti}} [[File:WelcomeToKamino-ARCT.png|thumb|right|250px|Kenobi and Skywalker meet with Shaak Ti and Lama Su while the 501st Legion disembarks.]] Upon learning of the impending invasion, Su could not believe that the Separatists would risk pitting themselves against the fortified blockade of the world, though all of them took the threat seriously and made preparations to defend Tipoca City. Skywalker and Kenobi's troops from the 501st Legion disembarked from the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class transport]], and Rex and Cody took their men directly to the Military Complex, which was being prepared for the attack. In addition, the Republic's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] were mobilized to mount an air strike against a Separatist attack. Meanwhile in deep [[Realspace/Legends|space]], Grievous made his own final preparations for the assault, commanding his fleet of three [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyers]] and ten [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]] from his [[Grievous's Providence-class carrier/destroyer (Kamino)/Legends|command ship]], a [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]]. The re-entry capsules containing the landing force of battle droids and pieces of ''Trident''-class assault ships were affixed to the main [[Hull/Legends|hulls]] of the ''Munificent''-class [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] as planned. The Separatists planned to attack Tipoca City first, while Grievous and Ventress were interested to meet each other on the battlefield for the first [[Time/Legends|time]], face to face. ==The battle== ===Distraction in space=== {{Quote|I'm going to press the attack, Master.''"
"''No, Anakin. Wait! It's too easy. Not even Grievous would attack so recklessly.''"
"''Master, the battle's up here in space, not down there.''"
"''The debris from the destroyed Separatist ships is the key.|Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi|}} [[File:ReentryCapsules-ARCT.png|thumb|left|250px|Grievous's frigates endure extensive damage to deploy the disguised re-entry capsules.]] Emerging from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], Grievous's invasion fleet entered the Kamino [[Star system/Legends|system]]. Aided by the [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] [[TV-94B/Legends|TV-94B]], Grievous deployed his armada in attack formation [[Echo-3/Legends|Echo-3]], with his ''Recusant''-class light [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyers]] spearheading the assault. As the enemy fleet began its offensive, the ten ''Venator''-class Star Destroyers of the Republic blockade held their position and returned the heavy [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] [[Laser/Legends|fire]], supplemented by a pair of [[Arquitens-class light cruiser/Legends|''Arquitens''-class light cruisers]] as well as Skywalker and Kenobi's ''Acclamator''-class [[Transport/Legends|transport]]. Commanding the Republic fleet with [[Clone navigation officer/Legends|clone naval officers]] from the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the ''Resolute'', Admiral Yularen was intrigued by Grievous's head-on assault, as such a move was odd for the Confederate general, and included the anomaly in a report to the command at Tipoca City. The update was received by Kenobi, Ti, Su, and Cody and Rex, who were overseeing the battle from the Military Complex's command center. As the Separatist armada pressed its attack, Cody had the Republic fleet shore up on defenses, while Ti—who had expected a larger invasion fleet—issued the order for the Republic's air strike. Kenobi meanwhile pondered why Grievous had forgone the element of surprise in favor of a direct approach for the attack. Responding to Ti's command, Skywalker led the Republic's starfighter squadrons—including his own personal group, [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]], with [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]] [[Broadside/Legends|Broadside]] among them—from Tipoca City into space aboard his [[Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]]. Taking up position at the head of Shadow Squadron, Skywalker led groups of [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]] and [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighters]] against Grievous's opposing fleet, which responded by launching [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]] to [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]] the Republic squadrons. At the same time, [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]] were marshaled in the defense of the Republic blockade from Separatist [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|''Hyena''-class bombers]]. Skywalker worked with another [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]], who was also [[Pilot/Legends|flying]] a [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B interceptor]], to prevent the enemy ships from reaching the surface of Kamino. The two [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] spearheaded the assault on the frigates and destroyers of the Separatist armada, which quickly began to take heavy losses. The damage was intentional, however, as it allowed the re-entry capsules to detach from the frigates while giving credence to their cover as debris. To the Republic, it simply appeared that Grievous was sacrificing the frigates to protect his [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]]. Grievous joined his aqua droids and [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] in the re-entry capsules and fell from [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], through the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of Kamino, and straight into the [[Water/Legends|waters]] surrounding Tipoca City, where they were received by Ventress. Once Grievous and his reinforcements had arrived, Ventress sent out her aqua droids to begin work reassembling the ''Trident''-class assault ships in preparation for the assault on Tipoca City. Back in space, the Republic fleet and starfighter squadrons held strong against the Separatist armada and its defenses, which began to take a beating from the intense fire. Skywalker led Shadow Squadron into the heart of the battle, pressing his attack by focusing on the Separatist frigates. The offensive allowed more wreckage-disguised capsules to reach the ocean floor of Kamino, ready for reassembly. As the Separatist armada began to retreat from Kamino, Kenobi [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] that something was amiss, as not even Grievous would mount such a reckless attack on the blockade. Because Grievous knew that they had been ready to defend Kamino, Kenobi believed that the starship debris was key to uncovering whatever the Separatists were planning. To that end, he decided to take a [[Kamino submarine/Legends|single-seater submarine]] to investigate the downed starship wreckage, keeping in contact with Skywalker as he did so. It was not long before Kenobi discovered Ventress's aqua droids reassembling the ''Trident''-class assault ships, many of which had already been completed by that time. Realizing the Separatists' deception, Kenobi attempted to warn Skywalker and Ti of the underwater assault craft, but he was too deep for his signal to be transmitted. [[File:TridentDrills-ARCT.png|thumb|right|250px|Reassembled by Ventress's aqua droids, ''Trident''-class assault ships attack Tipoca City.]] Shortly thereafter, one of the aqua droids noticed Kenobi's submarine and ordered him to stop. When a team of aqua droids clambered onto his ship and targeted its [[Window/Legends|window]] and [[Engine/Legends|engines]], Kenobi ejected from his submarine via an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]], but the aqua droids continued to pursue him. After being forced to abandon his escape pod, the [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]-low Kenobi made for the surface, using the Force to [[Animal bond|call]] to a nearby [[Aiwha/Legends|aiwha]] for aid. With the help of the aiwha, Kenobi returned to the surface, gasping for breath. His relief was short-lived, as it was at that moment that Ventress led her ''Trident'' and the completed ''Trident''-class assault ships out of the ocean to attack Tipoca City. As soon as Kenobi made him aware via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] of the Confederacy's assault on Tipoca City, Skywalker ordered all of the Republic's starfighter squadrons back to the ''Resolute'' while he immediately made for the surface in his Delta-7B interceptor. The Separatist fleet continued to retreat, though the battle over Kamino was no longer of concern to the Republic forces. The battlefield now became Tipoca City. ===Assault on Tipoca City=== {{Quote|Keep playing with your droids. I'll handle breaking into the DNA room.''"
"''Shall I provide you with a droid escort?''"
"''My dear General, there's nothing you have that I could want.|Asajj Ventress and General Grievous, separating to complete their mission objectives|}} [[File:BattleOfKamino-ARCT.png|thumb|left|250px|Clone troopers defend Tipoca City from Separatist aqua droids and assault ships.]] As the ''Trident''-class assault ships moved into position to [[Ground warfare/Legends|deploy]] their battle droid troops, Tipoca City was put on alert, and clone troopers rushed to defend the Military Complex. [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Colt/Legends|Colt]] was placed in charge of his fellow elite [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commandos]] who were assigned to the defense of Tipoca City,{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|packtype=2010 Basic Figure|pack=#52: Clone Commander Colt|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCW52-Colt.asp}} and they took up position within the Military Complex. While the defense of Tipoca City's main [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] was being organized, ARC Commander [[Havoc (ARC trooper)/Legends|Havoc]] sent 501st troopers [[Echo/Legends|Echo]] and [[Fives/Legends|Fives]] to take up [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] positions on the bridge connecting the hangar deck to the cloning factories. [[Unidentified Advanced Recon Commando 3/Legends|Another]] of the Advanced Recon [[Commando/Legends|Commandos]] joined his clone brethren in fortifying the main hangar just as several ''Trident''-class assault ships clambered onto the facility. The assault ships rammed their [[drill-spike]]s into the walls of the hangar's roof, penetrating the building to deploy their battle-ready aqua droids. A furious [[Lightfight|firefight]] ensued in the hangar, with the clones attempting to hold out against the seemingly never-ending line of aqua droids. Having arrived in one of the assault ships, Grievous personally led the assault on the clones, ordering his troops to spare none of the Republic troopers. Several Advanced Recon Commandos, including ARC Commanders Havoc and [[Blitz/Legends|Blitz]], oversaw the defense of the main hangar against Grievous's invading troops. Maintenance clone [[99/Legends|99]] helped resupply the clones with [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifles]], though he was forced to abandon his post as the [[Death/Legends|casualties]] around him mounted, particularly as Havoc fell to enemy [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire. Besieged by the ''Trident''-class assault ships, Tipoca City began to take heavy damage, with a large amount of its factories' [[Kamino cloning chamber|cloning chambers]] breaking apart as explosions gripped the city. While Grievous pushed further into the Military Complex, Ventress led her aqua droids against clone troopers on the city's outer decks, with the Confederate assault ships going so far as to smash through the clones with their heavy [[Limb/Legends|leg]] units. Elsewhere, Grievous ordered another attack on Tipoca City, but Commander Cody and the Jedi Knight who had assisted Skywalker in the space battle over Kamino prepared a defense of the area. Cody had a series of platforms constructed in the ocean so that their forces could utilize tower-mounted blaster turrets against Grievous's battle group. The Republic detachment was supplemented by a number of Advanced Recon Commandos, who took up positions in bunkers along the Separatists' intended path. Cody and the Jedi Knight were able to push back Grievous's initial force of battle droids and [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]], and Grievous was forced to recall his forces to regroup for their next assault. Striking swiftly, Grievous bolstered his forces with [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielded]] [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]], [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]], and [[NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcer/Legends|NR-N99 ''Persuader''-class droid enforcer]] [[Tank/Legends|tanks]], while he hoped to catch the clone detachment unprepared by deploying aerial droid-manned [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|Single Trooper Aerial Platforms]] and droid starfighters. Nevertheless, Cody and the Jedi Knight held out against his attack, shooting down the dispatched Vulture droid starfighters and [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|droid tri-fighters]] and prompting Grievous's forces to retreat a second time. With a storm brewing over Tipoca City, Grievous organized a final push against the Republic forces. While Cody and the Jedi Knight attempted to hold the line, Grievous had a number of ''Trident''-class assault ships emerge from the ocean and land even more battle droids across the facility. After noticing that the Republic's rear defenses were weak, Grievous launched a surprise attack by ordering his assault ships to target a position well behind the Republic's front line, forcing Cody and the Jedi Knight to readjust their defenses. The Republic detachment ultimately prevailed over Grievous's battle group, and the Separatists recalled their forces from that battlefront. Yet the battle for Tipoca City was far from over. [[File:SkywalkerKenobi-ARCT.png|thumb|right|250px|Kenobi and Skywalker lead clone troopers in defending Tipoca City from aqua droids.]] Across the Military Complex, [[Youngling/Legends|young]] [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadets]] were ushered to safety while their older brethren held out against the invading battle droids. With Shaak Ti and Lama Su coordinating defenses from the city's command center, Skywalker and Kenobi proceeded into the fray, leading a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of clone troopers against a group of aqua droids. Both Jedi Generals soon came to the conclusion that there were not enough battle droids to capture the entire city. Realizing that the Separatists were distracting them, Kenobi resolved to confront Grievous while Skywalker proceeded to secure the DNA archive [[Library/Legends|library]]. Echo and Fives fought on their own battlefront, defending the bridge from squads of aqua droids. 99 arrived to supply them with more ammunition, at which point Fives inquired if there was a better vantage point in the area. At that moment, four B1 battle droids ambushed them, but Fives summarily tossed one of 99's [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] at their attackers. What were thought to be more droids approaching through the smoke turned out to be five clone [[Cadet/Legends|cadets]] who had been separated from their group en route to the barracks. Fives and Echo decided to escort them there, with 99 leading them on a shortcut through the city. In one of the city's hallways, Grievous pressed through clone defenses led by Commander Colt with a group of B1 battle droids. When the rest of his men fell to droid fire, Colt mounted a last stand against the battle droids, but he was interrupted by Ventress, who had arrived to rendezvous with Grievous. Ventress gripped Colt in a [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force choke]], then activated one of her [[Asajj Ventress's lightsabers/Legends|lightsabers]] and pulled him onto her [[Lightsaber/Legends|blade]] with the Force, [[Shiak|impaling]] and killing him. Although Grievous was impressed with her display of power, Ventress had no respect for the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] general, refusing his offer for a droid escort on her mission to steal the clone DNA sample. Grievous meanwhile continued on to destroy the barracks, which would further seal a Separatist victory on Kamino. ===Republic retaliation=== {{Quote|Look around, we're one and the same. Same heart, same ''blood''. Your training is in your blood. And my blood's boiling for a ''fight''.''"
"''This is our home. This is ''our'' war.|Fives and Echo, rallying clone cadets to defend their home|}} [[File:TiDefendsHangar-ARCT.png|thumb|left|250px|Shaak Ti heads the clone troopers' defense of the main hangar from the battle droids.]] The Separatists continued to push back the clone forces across Tipoca City, with troops on the outer platforms losing ground. One squad of aqua droids breached the Military Complex's command center, where Ti, Su, and several clones were still overseeing the battle. Ti made quick work of the droids with her lightsaber, even destroying some of them by hurling them against a wall with the Force. She then ordered the Republic forces to push their offensive, as the droids were spread thin across the city. Fives, Echo, and 99 reached the barracks with their group of clone cadets, where Captain Rex and Commander Cody arrived to rally the young cadets to defend their homeworld. Fives and Echo also encouraged them to take up arms to protect their home. 99 brought Rex and Cody to the nearby armory to equip the cadets with weaponry for a defense of the barracks. The three of them returned with enough [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15Ss]] for the cadets, whom Rex positioned in the barracks' retractable [[Sleep/Legends|sleeping]] chambers so that they could surprise the droids from behind. They were just in time, as Grievous arrived with his detachment of B1 battle droids and aqua droids. While the droids pressed into the barracks and began a firefight with Rex, Cody, and their men, Kenobi arrived to confront Grievous in the hallway outside, with the two rivals [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|beginning]] a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]]. As he dueled with Kenobi, Grievous grabbed his opponent and threw him to the ground, then attempted to crush him beneath his mechanical feet. Kenobi managed to avoid the cyborg's powerful stamps, but he was then tossed against the ceiling and hit the ground hard. Although winded, Kenobi refused to concede to Grievous's assertion that Kamino had fallen, reaching out with the Force to slam Grievous against a wall. Taken off-guard by the offensive, Grievous retreated from the barracks, with Kenobi following close behind. Meanwhile, Ventress infiltrated the DNA archive room and stole a canister containing Jango Fett's DNA. Just as she secured her objective, Skywalker arrived, lightsaber in hand, to retrieve the DNA sample. The pair of familiar adversaries briefly reacquainted themselves before engaging in lightsaber combat. Ventress somersaulted over Skywalker and Force-pushed him against the DNA archive shelf, though Skywalker recovered quickly and re-engaged her. As their fierce duel moved into the hallway, Skywalker made a grab for the DNA canister on her [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]], but Ventress was too quick for him and thwarted his attempt at retrieval. Skywalker responded by pressing his attack, driving Ventress backward before locking blades with the Dark Acolyte in an effort to overpower her. However, Ventress simply kicked Skywalker backward, taking advantage of his brief distraction to escape with the DNA canister, with Skywalker in hot pursuit. While the Jedi were pursuing the Separatist agents out of Tipoca City, Rex, Cody, Fives, and Echo mounted a defense of the barracks from the invading battle droids. The clones took up positions behind several crates to return the droids' blaster fire, with 99 supplying Rex and Cody with thermal detonators to launch at the droids. Once the droids had passed the cadets' hiding spots in the sleeping chambers, Rex commed the cadets to open fire on the droids, effectively surrounding the droids and locking them in a crossfire. Cody soon used up their supply of thermal detonators, at which point 99 opted to restock their explosives from the armory. As 99 abandoned his cover behind the crates, much to his fellow clones' alarm, one of the droids' blaster shots caught him in the leg. Desperate to protect their injured comrade, Echo and Fives increased their blaster fire, with Fives forgoing his cover to eliminate the droids with his heavy [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]. Yet 99 took two more shots, this time fatal, to his back. The battle left no time for the clones to mourn their fallen comrade, as Cody received word from Ti that the rest of the droids throughout the city had been pushed back to the main hangar. Ti entered the fray in the hangar, joining the Republic troops in battling the remaining groups of aqua droids. [[File:Ventress_Push_ARCT.png|thumb|right|250px|An outnumbered Ventress unleashes a Force repulse to escape from Skywalker and his men.]] With Kenobi trailing him, Grievous reached one of the outer landing platforms and climbed onto its underside, surprising Kenobi from behind once he arrived. As Grievous and Kenobi circled each other, a ''Trident''-class assault ship clambered onto the platform, and the droid [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] used one of its leg units to compromise the platform's supports. Kenobi fell toward the sea many [[Meter/Legends|meters]] below, while Grievous reached an adjacent platform. Believing that Kenobi had drowned, Grievous boarded a [[Kaminoan flight pod/Legends|Kamino flight pod]] to retrieve Ventress, unaware that Kenobi had summoned the aiwha that had saved him earlier to be pulled out of the water. In the main hangar, Ti and her men continued to cut through the trapped droids, with the clones using blasters, [[Z-6 rotary blaster cannon/Legends|Z-6 rotary blaster cannons]], and [[RPS-6 rocket launcher/Legends|RPS-6 rocket launchers]] to annihilate the remaining assault ships. Once their hold on the hangar wall was compromised, the drill ships tumbled into the ocean below. On the outside platforms, ARC Commander Blitz led a squad of [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|Advanced Recon Force troopers]] to target an assault ship that was about to penetrate a city wall with its drill-spike. Blitz had one of his troopers [[Missile launcher/Legends|fire]] a [[Missile/Legends|rocket]] at the craft, causing it to crash onto a platform below. The compromised Trident drill fell in the path of Ventress, who was being pursued by Skywalker onto the outer decks. Dueling furiously, both adversaries avoided the ship and paid it little attention. A number of nearby clone troopers caught sight of Skywalker and went to his aid just as he kicked Ventress to the ground, then used the Force to retrieve the stolen DNA canister. The infuriated Ventress immediately retaliated, forcing Skywalker backward and knocking him to the ground before pulling the canister toward her with the Force. At that moment, the clone troopers arrived to assist Skywalker, and one of them grabbed the DNA sample in mid-air before it could reach Ventress. Now outnumbered by Skywalker and his men, the Dark Acolyte expected to be forced to surrender, though Skywalker intended to have the clones execute her on sight. Receiving a signal that Grievous was approaching in their escape vessel, Ventress refused to submit and unleashed a powerful Force repulse, knocking the Jedi and clones off their feet. Dodging the clones' blaster fire, Ventress jumped aboard Grievous's craft. The rival Separatist commanders escaped from Kamino, neither of them having completed their objective. The remaining Separatist forces in Tipoca City were routed, resulting in a Republic victory. ==Aftermath== {{Quote|I don't think the Separatists will be coming back here anytime soon. But if they do, Kamino will be lucky to have clones like you defending it. Good job, men.|Captain Rex, as part of Fives and Echo's promotion to ARC trooper status|}} [[File:FivesEchoPromoted-ARCT.png|thumb|left|250px|Fives and Echo are promoted to ARC trooper status by Rex and Cody for their performance.]] The Battle of Kamino, as it came to be called, became known as one of the key campaigns of the Clone Wars.{{SWE|characters|asajjventress|Asajj Ventress}} It was also referred to as the Invasion of Kamino and the defense of Kamino.{{SWArchive|url=clonewars/tradingcards/cards/lg_arctrooperecho.jpg|text=Clone Card: ARC trooper Echo|nobackup=1}} The death of 99 during the battle saddened many of his clone brethren; in the words of Commander Cody, the Grand Army lost a true [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] that [[Standard day/Legends|day]], for 99 had a warrior's [[Heart/Legends|heart]] despite his malformation as a clone. Although the Confederacy had failed to cripple the cloning factories or steal a sample of Jango Fett's DNA, they left extensive damage to Tipoca City, particularly to a number of cloning chamber towers. Following the Republic's victory, the clone cadets and troopers of Tipoca City, supervised by several Advanced Recon Commandos, set to work restoring the Military Complex, as well as recording the large amount of casualties and taking the injured to receive medical treatment. Additionally, some of the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] cloners set to work assessing the damage to the main hangar. For their display of valor in defending Kamino, Fives and Echo were promoted to the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of ARC trooper by Cody and Captain Rex. Having been squadmates in [[Domino Squad/Legends|Domino Squad]] during their training,{{TCW|Clone Cadets}} the two 501st troopers were honored to become the Grand Army's newest Advanced Recon Commandos. Jedi who participated in the Battle of Kamino recorded their experiences in [[Datafile/Legends|datafiles]] that were published in the collection known as the [[Jedi Battle Logs]].{{TCWA|set=Jedi Battle Logs Vol 2}} Long after the war, Cody would mention his time fighting on Kamino as one of the many worlds where he and the Jedi Order had stood tirelessly against Grievous's droid army.{{YouTube|video=F43h-fKN9Wo|text=Star Wars: TCW TV spot Cody|channel=channel/UC4cHyESkj-2t56kNeNGmidA|name=Willhemine}} ==Behind the scenes== ===Depiction=== {{Quote|Trident drill ships rise out of the water and attack the Kamino facility, while clones are desperate to save their home. That's worth doing. Absolutely.|Supervising Director Dave Filoni, on the task of portraying Kamino for the television series|[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Three|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Three]]}} The Battle of Kamino was created for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series and was featured in the episode "[[ARC Troopers (episode)|ARC Troopers]]," which aired on [[September 17]], [[2010]] as part of the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] premiere. Prior to then, the battle was featured in promotional material for the season in [[April]] 2010{{SW|url=video/the-clone-wars-season-three-preview-sneak-peak|text=The Clone Wars Season Three Preview}} and was confirmed in [[Star Wars Insider 120|''Star Wars Insider'' 120]].{{InsiderCite|120|Launchpad}} A [[The Clone Wars: Season One|Season One]] promotional commercial had also inadvertently teased the battle by featuring Commander Cody mention he had fought a battle on Kamino during the Clone Wars. "ARC Troopers" served as a sequel to "[[Rookies (episode)|Rookies]]," an episode from the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] that focused primarily on such clone trooper characters as Captain Rex, Cody, Fives, and Echo. Originally, the Battle of Kamino was to have immediately followed the battle at Rishi Station depicted in "Rookies," but it was moved farther down the timeline to allow Fives and Echo to have more experience prior to their promotion to ARC troopers. The battle featured the debut of the aqua droids, an aquatic battle droid model developed for the series. A [[September 18]], 2010 update to the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'' video game]] depicted the battle in the mini-games "Republic Defender" and "Starfighter," in addition to attributing the battle its official name. [[File:VentressFlirty-ARCTroopers.png|thumb|right|250px|Grievous and Ventress meet each other in person for the first time during the battle.]] During production for the space portion of the battle, Series Supervising Director [[Dave Filoni]] made sure to have the episode's director, [[Kyle Dunlevy]], raise the bar in terms of its scale.[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Three|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Three]], "Creating Kamino" Featurette In keeping with established ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the battle was written so that Anakin Skywalker would not encounter General Grievous, as the film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] established that they were introduced to each other at the later [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]. A scene of Asajj Ventress [[:File:VentressKissColt-ARCT.png|kissing]] Commander Colt on the cheek just after killing him was removed from the episode due to insistence from [[Cartoon Network]];{{WebCite|url=http://www.bigshinyrobot.com/reviews/archives/16255|text=Big Shiny Robot - Did Clone Wars Get Censored?|author=Young, Bryan ("Swank-mo-tron")|date=2010-09-11|work=Bigshinyrobot.com|archivedate=20111217230233}} the sequence was included in the episode as part of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Three|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Three]] DVD release. Grievous and Ventress's meeting during the battle represented a [[Retroactive continuity|retcon]] to previously established continuity from the [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]],{{CWACite|3|Rogue's Gallery}} as it was stated to be their first face-to-face meeting despite the fact that such an [[Mission to Trenchant space station|encounter]] had already been depicted in the short [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] ''[[Rogue's Gallery]]'' in [[2005]]. [[Star Wars Insider 125|''Star Wars Insider'' 125]] ranked the Battle of Kamino alongside the earlier [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]], the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]], and the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]] as one of the largest battles depicted in the series.{{InsiderCite|125|50 Great Reasons to Rewatch Star Wars: The Clone Wars Season Three|50 Great Reasons to Rewatch ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Season Three}} In April [[2012]], [[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide: Updated and Expanded|''The Ultimate Visual Guide: Updated and Expanded'']] placed the battle within a timeline of the series' events, between the events of the episodes "[[Sphere of Influence]]" and "[[The Mandalore Plot]]."''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide: Updated and Expanded]]'' The battle's placement was revised in the [[2013]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]'', which moved it between the events of "[[Assassin (episode)|Assassin]]" and "Sphere of Influence." ===Inconsistencies=== Visible in the Tipoca City command center scenes in "ARC Troopers" is a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of a trio of [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ships]] that are part of Grievous's fleet. However, since they do not appear in the space battle scenes, this article assumes this is an animation error. The portrayal of the Battle of Kamino in the young readers' novel ''[[The Clone Wars: Defenders of the Republic]]'' differs in numerous places from the battle's depiction in "ARC Troopers." In all cases, this article follows the episode's presentation of the battle. During the Battle of Kamino, a 501st Legion Clone Trooper wearing [[Mixer]]'s armor appears in the battle. This however cannot be right because Mixer [[Death|dies]] by an [[SD-K4 assassin droid|assassin probe droid]] in the episode "[[Voyage of Temptation]]" which takes place before the Battle of Kamino. This is either an animation error or another clone with the exact same markings. In ''Defenders of the Republic'', Skywalker, Kenobi, and their men travel to Tipoca City in a Republic [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] instead of an ''Acclamator''-class transport. After the invasion of Tipoca City begins, Skywalker is assigned to take some of the young clone cadets to a secure location to wait out the fighting. He eventually comes upon Fives, Echo, and 99 on the bridge, and the three clones decide to take the cadets to the barracks while Skywalker departs to protect the DNA archive library. This is not the case in the episode, in which the cadets are separated from their group and come across Fives, Echo, and 99 on their own without Skywalker. Just prior to Grievous's rendezvous with Ventress in Tipoca City, some advanced clone cadets concentrate their fire on a nearby ''Trident''-class assault ship. Ventress makes her entrance by killing the cadets instead of Commander Colt in the episode. For the defense of the clone barracks, the book depicts a larger number of clone cadets—an "army"—serving under Captain Rex and Commander Cody, whereas in the episode the cadets only amount to five. Rex does not instruct the cadets to take up position in the sleeping chambers; the clones engage the battle droids from one direction for the entirety of the firefight. [[File:AnakinVentressDuel-Kamino.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Ventress and Skywalker's duel was adjusted in ''Defenders of the Republic''.]] While assisting in pushing the droids back to the main hangar, Shaak Ti protects a group of inexperienced cadets from a large [[Octuptarra magna tri-droid/Legends|octuptarra magna tri-droid]], which she charges and destroys. Immediately thereafter, Ventress arrives in the hangar with Skywalker in pursuit instead of on one of the outer platforms. ARC Commander Blitz is present in the hangar and orders his men to fire at Ventress, who deflects the blaster fire. On the other hand, the episode depicts Blitz on an outer platform, where he has one of his ARF troopers fire a missile at a ''Trident''-class assault ship. ===Non-canon history=== ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.16|Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic UK 6.16]]'' published an [[Infinities]] version of "ARC Troopers" in which the Battle of Kamino is depicted differently. In that version, Skywalker confronts General Grievous on an outer landing platform, while Obi-Wan Kenobi intercepts Ventress at the DNA archive room. During his duel with Ventress, Kenobi [[Cho sun/Legends|slices off]] her right arm and Force-pushes her other lightsaber out of reach, allowing her to be taken [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] by a squad of Advanced Recon Commandos. Meanwhile, Skywalker fiercely duels Grievous and eventually manages to sever all four of his mechanical arms, and the cyborg is taken into custody alongside Ventress. Following the battle, Grievous refuses to submit to Jedi interrogation and is imprisoned by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] in the deepest level of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] capital of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], left in his dismembered state. The [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] also attempts to bring Ventress back into the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]], seeing if they can purge her anger so that she might be able to offer intelligence on [[Count/Legends|Count]] Dooku's [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.16|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic
